title: clompanus barteri
intro: Clompanus barteri, commonly known as African bush mango or bush mango, is a plant species native to tropical West Africa. The health benefits of Clompanus barteri include its use in traditional medicine to treat various ailments such as fever, rheumatism, and digestive issues. Clompanus barteri is reported to have therapeutic actions including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which contribute to its health benefits. The bioactive constituents of Clompanus barteri include flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
